title: ee.mesh.approval_token.v1
description: Public projection of an explicitly issued, short-lived mesh lane-approval bearer. The opaque value contains the fresh nonce, nonce-salted keyed snapshot tag, bounded timestamps, and context-bound envelope MAC. Those internals are not separate public fields. This projection deliberately contains no stable store, workspace, or key identifier. Ordinary previews omit the entire object. An opted-in value may remain in a third-party stdout or session recorder until expiry; ee-controlled sinks must redact it.

value.description: Opaque, current-key-only fixed-width v1 approval bearer. Consumers must pass it through bounded stdin using --preview-token-stdin; never argv or an environment variable.

expiresAt.description: Expiry of this bearer. V1 issuance uses a 900-second TTL.

handling.description: Load-bearing marker: redact the value from ee-controlled tracing, errors, audit, support artifacts, and imported session material.
